chapter: Teenage bands and Florida road tours
title: Local ballroom gigs and the pay
summary: The Cavaliers undercut Hartley Toots for ballrooms and clubs and shared about a dollar a man a night.

bands.name: Hartley Toots and his Orange Pickers

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: And you guys played around at parties?

Oh, no; we had a big band, man. We played the ballrooms; we played all of the clubs -- that Hartley Toots wasn't able to play for, and they were able to get us cheaper anyway, so we got a lot of the gigs that Hartley Toots would have been playing. We played at the Elks, [Best.]
What was the going price for a night's gig then?
Well, I tell you. We used to share, like a dollar a man, and a dollar and a quarter for most.
Yeah, that's what we got for the gig.
Well, it was a start, though.
